name: Ares
source:
He is the best swordsman in the kingdom and Minerva's husband. Although he is a skilled swordsman, he is not a strategist. He gives up his position as general to Minerva and solely on focus being a warrior.

Because of his abilities and his position as a warrior, he is assigned to defend the Thracian kingdom during this expedition.

[Translated from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/ingoku/]official site[/url]]
